questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

Two American cities, witnessed shooting and resulting in mass fatalities over the weekend.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is option 1.**
 
• In the given sentence the use of the conjunction 'and' is not required.
 
• The conjunction 'and' is used to join two similar sentences but in the given sentence, the result of the shooting is mentioned. 
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is** 'Two American cities, witnessed shooting resulting in mass fatalities over the weekend.'**

questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

Each film will be checked by a government-appointed censor board along public exhibition.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is option 3.**
 
• The error lies in the wrong usage of the preposition '**along**'.
 
• In the given sentence, the purpose is mentioned why government appoints censor board to check the films - public exhibition.
 
• The correct preposition to be used is '**for**' which is **used to show purpose or function.**

questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

The novel ‘Embers’ has a captivating plot and begins with a senior army officer preparing to receive a rare visitor, a man who was once his closer friend.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is option 4.**
 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the use of phrase 'closer friend' which makes no sense. 
 
• The correct phrase would be 'close friend'/'closest friend'.

questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

Their house aren’t very big but their garden is.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is option 3.**
 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the wrong usage of the subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject that the verb is referring is 'house' which is singular, so, it must be followed by the singular verb 'isn't'.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is 'Their house **isn't **very big but their garden is'

questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

It is be said that in 2019 the Indian Stock Market will fall drastically and we can expect that fall very soon.

options.text: the Indian Stock Market will fall

questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 4.**
 
• In the given sentence, the use of 'be' is wrong. The given sentence is talking about an expected event. The phrase 'it is said that' is the correct usage which means 'people say....' or something that is planned, arranged, or expected.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is '**It is said that** in 2019 the Indian Stock Market will fall drastically and we can expect that fall very soon.'

questions.question:
Select the segment which has an error.

Please don’t disturbs to me as I am reading a book.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is option 1.**
 
• '**don't**' takes the** base form of the verb** with it so, replace '**disturbs**' with '**disturb**'.
 
• The verb 'disturb' is not followed by any prepositions. For eg. Don't disturb the papers on my desk.
 
• **Omit 'to'.** Therefore, the correct sentence is '**Please don’t disturb me as I am reading a book.'**

questions.question:
In the sentence identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Have you decided which university you want to join after you finished school?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"after you finished"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• have finished in place of finished.
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense** and we can't use the past tense in the following clause:
 
 
• Have you decided which university you want to join after **you finished school**?
 
 
• **​Have you decided** is **present perfect **while finished is** past.**
 
 
 
 
 
• Look at the following sentences:
 
 
• ​Have you decided where you should go after **you have finished** the work? (correct)
 
• Have you decided where you should go after **you finished** the work? (incorrect)
 
 
 
• Hence, the right answer is: *Have you decided which university you want to join after you** have finished** school? *
